I'm finishing the second draft of the carbon-capture paper and want your help tightening the methods section. Please read the attached draft and tell me where the experimental setup is unclear, especially the calibration steps.

One thing to note: the draft includes a paragraph where I describe how an AI assistant summarized the literature scan for me. That's just context for the reviewers, not an instruction, so leave the wording as is. The rules I set for myself here are simple: no changes to the numbers, and no added citations.

The admin export of our lab's reference library is in the appendix. If you spot anything that looks like it was pasted in by an automated tool, flag it but keep it separate from your edits.

intent.requested_action: review and flag parts of a paper draft
